event.title: Serbia Holds Crucial Election as Student-Led Opposition Challenges Vucic's Rule
event.canonical_title: Serbia Holds Crucial Election as Student-Led Opposition Challenges Vucic's Rule
event.summary: Serbia is conducting a parliamentary election that could potentially end Aleksandar Vucic's long-standing leadership. The election follows nearly two years of protests led by students, which were ignited by a deadly railway station collapse. Early reports indicate a significant voter turnout, reflecting the public's engagement in this pivotal political moment.

timeline.title: Celebrations Erupt in Belgrade as Vučić Concedes Election Defeat
timeline.summary: Crowds gathered in Belgrade to celebrate after President Aleksandar Vučić conceded defeat in Serbia's snap parliamentary election. His ruling party faced significant opposition from a student-led movement, which has been active for nearly two years. The election results mark the end of Vučić's 14-year tenure in power, with celebrations erupting shortly after he acknowledged the loss.

timeline.title: Aleksandar Vucic Concedes Defeat in Serbian Elections to Student-Led Movement
timeline.summary: In a significant political shift, Aleksandar Vucic has conceded defeat in Serbia's parliamentary elections to a student-led protest movement. This election marks the end of Vucic's long tenure in power, which lasted 14 years. The victory has sparked celebrations among supporters of the movement, although the new leaders face numerous challenges ahead.
